section: Non-residents and foreign workers: employment income (Quellensteuer)
label: Who pays withholding tax on employment income
value: Foreign employees resident in Switzerland without a settlement permit (C), unless married to a Swiss citizen or C-permit holder (DBG art. 83), and employees living abroad on pay for work in Switzerland, such as cross-border commuters (art. 91)
note: Residence: a person is resident for tax purposes with a Swiss domicile or a stay of at least 30 days with work (90 days without work), as the withholding-tax section explains; tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in Switzerland. The cross-border rules are those of the ESTV dossier with legislation as of 1 January 2025.
source_title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 83, 91 and 99a; Fedlex: Quellensteuerverordnung des EFD (QStV, SR 642.118.2), Stand am 10. Januar 2025, Art. 1 and 14

section: Non-residents and foreign workers: employment income (Quellensteuer)
label: How it is collected
value: The employer deducts the tax from the gross pay and pays it to the cantonal tax authority; it covers the federal, cantonal and communal income tax, including church tax where due
note: Residence: a person is resident for tax purposes with a Swiss domicile or a stay of at least 30 days with work (90 days without work), as the withholding-tax section explains; tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in Switzerland. The cross-border rules are those of the ESTV dossier with legislation as of 1 January 2025.

section: Non-residents and foreign workers: employment income (Quellensteuer)
label: French cross-border commuters
value: Under the 1983 agreement, BE, SO, BS, BL, VD, VS, NE and JU withhold no tax; France taxes the pay and compensates these cantons with 4.5% of gross pay. Geneva taxes at source and pays 3.5% of the gross pay to the French border departments; other cantons tax at source without compensation
note: Residence: a person is resident for tax purposes with a Swiss domicile or a stay of at least 30 days with work (90 days without work), as the withholding-tax section explains; tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in Switzerland. The cross-border rules are those of the ESTV dossier with legislation as of 1 January 2025.

section: Non-residents and foreign workers: employment income (Quellensteuer)
label: Italian cross-border commuters
value: Since the 2020 agreement, GR, TI and VS withhold 80% of the ordinary withholding tax from new commuters (status since 18 July 2023); for earlier commuters they withhold the full tax and pass 40% to the Italian border municipalities
note: Residence: a person is resident for tax purposes with a Swiss domicile or a stay of at least 30 days with work (90 days without work), as the withholding-tax section explains; tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in Switzerland. section: Non-residents and foreign workers: employment income (Quellensteuer)

label: Official test: employee or self-employed
value: For AHV purposes, self-employed means working in one's own name and on one's own account, independently, and bearing one's own business risk; someone without a specific business risk who depends economically or organisationally on an employer is an employee. The economic facts count, not the contract
note: Cantons add their own withholding to the federal rates for non-resident artists, board members and creditors (each canton's rate differs).

section: Contractors: employment status (AHV) and withholding on fees

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Corporate tax (Gewinnsteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
value: federal 8.5% of net profit (4.25% for associations and foundations); cantonal and communal profit tax set by each canton; 15% OECD minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 (QDMTT since 2024, IIR since 2025). Paid by companies, cooperatives and other legal entities with seat, management or a permanent establishment in Switzerland. DBG art. 68 and 71; cantonal tax laws; MindStV of 22 December 2023.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [federal]
value: branch profits: profit tax at the normal rates, no separate branch tax; dividends and interest: 35% withholding tax (Verrechnungssteuer). Paid by the Swiss payer withholds it from the shareholder or creditor. DBG art. 51; Bundesgesetz über die Verrechnungssteuer (VStG).
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions: AHV/IV/EO [federal]
value: 10% of earned income from CHF 60,500, sliding scale from 5.371% below that, minimum CHF 530 a year, no ceiling; plus up to 5% administrative costs and the cantonal family-allowance contribution. Paid by self-employed people (through their AHV compensation fund). AHVG; IVG; EOG; AHV leaflet 2.02.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 Beiträge der Selbstständigerwerbenden an die AHV, die IV und die EO (Stand am 1. Januar 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Contractor or employee: AHV status test [federal]
value: the AHV compensation fund decides on the economic facts (own business risk, independence); no withholding on payments to resident contractors; federal withholding on fees to non-resident artists, athletes and speakers (0.8% to 7%) and board members (5%). Paid by clients who engage workers (AHV contributions where the work is employment). AHVG art. 5 and 9; BSV Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn; DBG art. 92 and 93.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 (Stand am 1. Januar 2026); BSV: Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn in der AHV, IV und EO (WML), Stand 1. Mai 2026, Rz 1013-1019

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Simplified regimes: VAT net tax rate method and simplified settlement [federal]
value: no simplified income tax; VAT registration from CHF 100,000 turnover; net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 VAT a year; 5% flat tax in the simplified settlement procedure for small wages. Paid by businesses that opt in. MWSTG art. 10 and 37; DBG art. 37a; Bundesgesetz gegen die Schwarzarbeit (BGSA).
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Fedlex: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG, SR 641.20), Stand am 1. Januar 2024, Art. 37; ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.1

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
value: withheld by the employer at the canton's tariff; ordinary assessment on request for quasi-residents (at least 90% of worldwide income taxed in Switzerland); German commuters at most 4.5%; Italian new commuters 80% of the tariff. Paid by non-resident employees and foreign residents without a C permit (withheld by the employer). DBG art. 83-101; QStV; StHG art. 32-38; tax treaties and cross-border agreements.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
value: in about half the cantons, mostly communal, 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the gross property value; none in ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; imputed rental value abolished from 1 January 2029 (vote of 28 September 2025). Paid by property owners. cantonal tax laws and municipal tax regulations.

label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
value: usually 1% to 3.3% of the purchase price; none as such in ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI (fees only). Paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise (half each in OW, BL and AR). cantonal transfer tax laws.
